summary: [[character:bob-replicant]] coordinates [[technology:roamers]] assembling ship components while [[character:dr-doucette]] covers for [[character:dr-landers]]. Their conversation recounts [[location:old-handeltown]]'s origins in Salem, Oregon, the city's renaming and memorial, the memorial's nuclear destruction, and the later move of Handeltown to Portland, as well as the State's expectation of public piety. Bob learns that Piety Monitors may be among security patrols and that the [[organization:ministry-of-proper-thought]] is a feared consequence of confronting them. When he asks how his handlers will ensure he follows the mission after release, Doucette says his software contains undisclosed safeguards; Bob worries that they may compel choices while still feeling like his own.

introducing.name: Dr. Doucette
introducing.description: A doctor at [[organization:applied-synergetics]] who is less talkative than [[character:dr-landers]] and speaks with the standard 22nd-century accent. She tells [[character:bob-replicant]] how [[location:old-handeltown]] was lost and, after checking for security patrols, speaks candidly about life under [[organization:free-american-independent-theocratic-hegemony]].
introducing.current_state: Covering for [[character:dr-landers]] while [[character:bob-replicant]] continues his training and assembly work.

introducing.name: translation routine
introducing.description: A routine that interprets the standard twenty-second-century accent so smoothly that differing speech patterns become effectively transparent to its user.

introducing.name: Old Handeltown
introducing.description: A historic Oregon city identified as Salem, Oregon and as Handel's birthplace. After Handel's death, the city changed its name and a large memorial was established in his honor. An unidentified person later destroyed the memorial with a pocket nuclear weapon after objecting. It was the only nuclear weapon deployed in North America, and advanced radiation treatment limited the resulting deaths. The Handeltown name then moved to Portland as [[location:new-handeltown]].

updates.current_state: Continuing training and assembly as the sole remaining probe candidate. His software safeguards remain incompletely understood.
Away from the project while [[character:dr-doucette]] covers for him.

updates.description: Remote observation and manipulation devices directed through [[technology:guppi-interface|GUPPI]]. They come in varied sizes, coordinate across scales and, once their tasks are defined, need little supervision. They can climb floors, walls and ceilings, carry video cameras and pick up vibrations through a wall. Reusable scripts automate routine work, leaving assembly largely self-directed.

Mostly harmless. The homeworld of [[species:human|humanity]]. Its places include [[location:las-vegas]], where [[character:robert-johansson|Bob]] dies in the [[event:bob-road-incident|road incident]] of 2016; [[location:new-handeltown]], formerly Portland, where he is revived as a replicant in 2133; and [[location:old-handeltown]], formerly Salem, Oregon, whose memorial to Handel was destroyed by a nuclear weapon.
